title: Pentaryn Feedback
description: A bug button in the left toolbar: players file a bug, defect or feature request with their recent actions and the live game context attached; the GM stores it as a file the repo's MCP tools read one at a time.

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), enable 'Pentaryn Feedback', then reload.
game.pentaryn.feedback.selftest()          // with a scene open, every check ok
File one as the GM: the bug button in the token tools (or /bug in chat), Bug selected, hover each category.
File one as a player in a second browser, then:
Offline path: GM logs out, a player files one (toast says queued), GM logs back in: the file appears.
